cap: In a normal pregnancy, trophoblast replaces the muscular wall of the spiral arteries, so the placenta gets a wide, low-resistance supply. In preeclampsia the invasion stays shallow, the placenta becomes ischemic and releases sFlt-1, which traps VEGF and injures maternal endothelium everywhere. That single chain explains hypertension, proteinuria, HELLP and seizures, and it explains why only delivery of the placenta cures the disease.
